description: This file defines a foreground service for recording audio, including the service class 'RecorderService' and its binder 'RecorderServiceBinder' which manages MediaRecorder lifecycle, recording state, and timing.

classes.name: RecorderService
classes.description: A foreground service managing audio recording lifecycle, providing binding for control.

classes.name: RecorderServiceBinder
classes.description: Binder class that manages MediaRecorder instance, recording state, timing, and unbinding.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the binder with lifecycle scope and application context.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the binder instance for clients binding to the service.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources and stops recording if active.

methods.name: killRecorder
methods.description: Stops and releases MediaRecorder, optionally stops the service.

methods.name: initializeRecorder
methods.description: Sets up MediaRecorder with output file and URI, prepares for recording.

methods.name: startRecording
methods.description: Starts recording and launches a coroutine to track recording time.

methods.name: stopRecordingAndUnbind
methods.description: Unbinds the service connection and stops recording.
